mining: Only explicitly admitted TRAIN crops with frozen-parent probability for the reviewed class below 0.8. No labels generated by the parent. No development-image mining.
checkpoint_policy: Fixed final epoch; no development checkpoint selection.
control: Same class counts and number of optimizer steps, resampled existing TRAIN crops with fixed sampling seed 47.
preservation: Keep 1487 ordinary/fragment rows and their parent-logit preservation loss unchanged. Hard rows use reviewed labels only.
evaluation: Compare both arms and the unchanged parent on all three frozen repeated-development panels at threshold 0.8, matching IoU 0.5, split_merged selection, aspect bound 2.42913421076193. These panels are not final qualification.
promotion_rule: No promotion from training fit alone. Require consistent blue benefit across seeds without red regression; assess against resampling controls, then recheck supported selection and Pi separately.
